policy.summary: A 1.0 release requires every internal benchmark capability to be owned, evidenced, and free of unknown or gap status.
policy.preOneZeroPolicy: Versions below 1.0 must keep this inventory current; 1.0.0 and later must have zero blocker statuses.
policy.sourceNaming: Use neutral source aliases only. Do not store upstream product names in this repository.

sources.evidence: Local checkout documentation and feature inventory reviewed outside this repository.
Local SDK runtime compatibility notes and bundle probes reviewed outside this repository.
Connected-host route, operator, channel, media, pairing, and automation contracts reviewed under source-b; packaged Agent docs mirror the owned boundaries.
Companion command-depth, pairing, shared-session, media attachment, and realtime foreground-event inventory reviewed under source-b.

items.capability: Terminal-first personal operator workspace launches by default and exposes the high-signal workflows from one TUI surface.
items.action: Keep Agent workspace as the first-screen product surface and avoid adding a marketing or coding-first front door.

items.capability: First-run setup covers provider access, Agent Knowledge, local behavior libraries, channels, voice/media, and connected-host posture.
items.action: Keep onboarding tied to Agent-owned settings and connected-host readiness checks.

items.capability: Provider and model selection includes active model visibility, custom provider setup, model refresh, pinned models, and reasoning effort.
items.action: Preserve workspace-first model/provider controls and scriptable mirrors.

items.capability: Provider auth and subscription posture are inspectable without printing tokens, with login/logout flows requiring explicit confirmation.
items.action: Keep account inspection read-only by default and confirmation-gate login mutations.

items.capability: Agent Knowledge uses the isolated Agent route family only, with ask, search, source review, connector inspection, ingest, reindex, and consolidation actions.
items.action: Never fall back to default knowledge or non-Agent product knowledge segments.

items.capability: Artifacts, file ingest, URL lists, bookmarks, browser history, and generated media are explicit Agent Knowledge or artifact workflows instead of silent memory promotion.
items.action: Keep source-to-knowledge handoff explicit and confirmation-gated.

items.capability: Agent-local memory, notes, personas, and runtime profiles support durable personal context without default knowledge contamination.
items.action: Keep local context libraries Agent-owned and secret-rejecting.

items.capability: Local skills, skill bundles, routines, and learned behavior capture reusable operator behavior from reviewed user workflows.
items.action: Keep behavior capture local until the user explicitly promotes or exports it.

items.capability: Local routines can be promoted to connected-host schedules only by explicit confirmation, with redacted receipts and reconciliation.
items.action: Keep local routine start separate from durable connected-host schedule creation.

items.capability: Reminder scheduling and notification delivery are explicit, confirmed, and routed through configured targets without leaking tokens.
items.action: Keep reminder delivery opt-in and redacted.

items.capability: Agent can inspect channel readiness, accounts, policies, status, setup guidance, and send one confirmed delivery.
items.action: Keep channel delivery exact-target and confirmation-gated.

items.capability: Companion pairing is QR-first, hides raw tokens by default, and requires explicit confirmation to display manual tokens.
items.action: Keep token display redacted unless the user explicitly asks for manual pairing output.

items.capability: Approvals, automation jobs, runs, and schedules expose read-only status plus narrow confirmed approve, deny, cancel, run, pause, resume, retry, and run-now actions.
items.action: Do not create or mutate broad automation definitions from ordinary chat.

items.capability: Planning, workplan status, and task visibility support personal operator work without auto-spawning parallel implementation jobs.
items.action: Keep planning serial and explicit until the user asks for execution.

items.capability: Build, fix, review, and implementation work delegates to GoodVibes TUI/shared-session routes only when the user explicitly asks.
items.action: Do not turn the personal Agent into a coding TUI or implicit reviewer.

items.capability: MCP servers, tool inventory, trust posture, secrets, and security review are inspectable and confirmation-gated from the Agent workspace.
items.action: Keep tool trust changes explicit and do not silently install or expose tools.

items.capability: Voice, live TTS, image input, media provider readiness, and confirmed image/video artifact generation are available from the TUI.
items.action: Keep spoken output and generated media out of durable knowledge unless explicitly ingested.

items.capability: Session save/load/export/search, transcript review, bookmarks, image attachment, and context references are handled inside the TUI.
items.action: Keep conversation controls local and visible.

items.capability: Support, auth, subscription, and trust bundles can be exported or inspected with redaction and explicit confirmation.
items.action: Keep sensitive bundle export confirmation-gated.

items.capability: Agent status, doctor, compatibility, health, auth review, and connected-host route posture are available from CLI and TUI.
items.action: Keep diagnostics read-only and linked to connected-host repair guidance.

items.capability: Package metadata, docs, Bun-only install, runtime build, compiled binary smoke, performance fixture checks, publish checks, install checks, and release workflows are guarded by shared release metadata verification.
items.evidence: release/1.0-performance-snapshot.json; src/cli/package-verification.ts; scripts/release.ts; scripts/perf-check.ts; scripts/publish-check.ts; scripts/package-install-check.ts; .github/workflows/ci.yml
items.action: Keep release validation centralized and package-facing docs aligned with Agent product boundaries.

items.capability: Live release verification records external outcome checks for compiled CLI, connected-host status, health, model routes, and isolated Agent Knowledge.
items.action: Run live verification for release candidates after product work is complete.

items.capability: The 1.0 readiness inventory is staged with release metadata and blocks 1.0.0+ when unknown or gap entries remain.
items.action: Keep this inventory current whenever benchmark evidence or ownership changes.

items.capability: Core external messaging surfaces, route bindings, delivery records, ingress, egress, account lifecycle, directory lookup, target resolution, and render policy are owned by the connected host and SDK.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: channel surface and automation contract inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/channels-remote-and-api.md
items.action: Agent should keep readiness and confirmed send UX while connected-host owns adapters and lifecycle.

items.capability: Durable jobs, runs, schedules, route bindings, deliveries, watchers, and service lifecycle are connected-host responsibilities.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: automation runtime and operator API contract inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/tools-and-commands.md
items.action: Agent should expose read-only status and narrow confirmed actions, not host lifecycle ownership.

items.capability: Operator API covers methods, events, auth, realtime transport, status, control-plane catalogs, and WebSocket/SSE event feeds.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: operator API and realtime transport contract inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/connected-host.md
items.action: Agent should use public operator routes only.

items.capability: The connected host owns Agent Knowledge route handlers, source ingestion, connectors, graph operations, refinement, jobs, and schedules.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: isolated Agent Knowledge route contract reviewed under source-b; docs/knowledge-artifacts-and-multimodal.md
items.action: Agent should target only the isolated Agent Knowledge route family.

items.capability: Voice synthesis, streaming voice, transcription, realtime voice session setup, media analysis, artifact storage, and media provider route handlers are connected-host responsibilities.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: media and voice route contract inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/voice-and-live-tts.md
items.action: Agent should keep TUI controls and artifact UX rather than provider runtime ownership.

items.capability: Provider account snapshots, usage windows, OAuth/service route metadata, and provider usage endpoints are owned by the connected host and SDK.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: provider account and usage route contract inventory reviewed under source-b; src/input/commands/provider-accounts-runtime.ts
items.action: Agent should inspect and guide provider auth without owning provider service internals.

items.capability: Companion pairing, token bootstrap, realtime event delivery, browser/mobile-safe SDK surfaces, and transport compatibility are connected-host and SDK responsibilities.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: pairing, token bootstrap, realtime, browser-safe, and mobile-safe transport inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/channels-remote-and-api.md
items.action: Agent should render pairing and status UX while the connected host owns token issuance and realtime transport.

items.capability: Batch provider jobs, queue signals, optional Cloudflare provisioning, worker proxying, DLQ posture, and batch tick processing are SDK/connected-host responsibilities.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: batch job, queue, worker proxy, DLQ, and tick-processing inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/connected-host.md
items.action: Agent should not implement cloud provisioning or batch worker internals.

items.capability: The full internal benchmark channel matrix includes additional long-tail chat surfaces beyond the current connected-host core surface set.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: long-tail channel type, plugin, enterprise delivery, bridge delivery, and setup-schema inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/channels-remote-and-api.md
items.action: Keep the long-tail channel matrix registered in the connected-host surface union, plugin registry, delivery strategies, setup schemas, and operator channel routes.

items.capability: The internal benchmark includes phone-call style conversation or notification delivery as a channel-class surface.
items.evidence: goodvibes-connected-host: telephony channel adapter and bridge delivery inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/channels-remote-and-api.md; src/agent/channel-delivery.ts; src/input/agent-workspace-channels.ts; src/agent/reminder-schedule.ts; src/agent/routine-schedule-args.ts
items.action: Keep telephony owned by the connected-host SDK and expose Agent readiness/send UX through existing channel routes.

items.capability: The internal benchmark includes deeper mobile-device command surfaces beyond pairing, chat, voice, camera/media attachment, and realtime client support.
items.evidence: goodvibes-companion: companion command-depth, pairing, chat, shared-session, approvals, tasks, provider/model controls, attachments, and realtime foreground-event inventory reviewed under source-b; docs/channels-remote-and-api.md
items.action: Keep the companion app aligned with SDK contracts for secure auth, QR pairing, companion chat, shared sessions, approvals, tasks, provider/model controls, attachments, and realtime foreground events.

items.capability: Every externally backed capability needs fresh live evidence before a 1.0 release candidate, including real channel sends, schedule execution, provider usage, media generation, pairing, and Agent Knowledge answers.
items.evidence: release/1.0-live-verification/live-verification.json; release/1.0-live-verification/live-verification.md; strict live verification on 2026-06-03 reported 14 pass, 0 warn, 0 fail, 0 skip against connected host SDK 0.33.35.
items.action: Keep strict live verification current for every release candidate and rerun it after connected-host, provider, channel, media, pairing, Agent Knowledge, or package-runtime changes.
